title: Coefficient coherence of normalized Koszul and Roos models
statement: For an essentially small ringed site, a ring sheaf R, a global section s and any Models R s satisfying Normalization of [def-sp-koszul-roos-comparison-data], every k <= m admits the canonical quotient map R/(s^(m+1)) -> R/(s^(k+1)), its ordinary restricted tensor transition b tensor x -> q(b) tensor x, and a derived restricted transition normalized by the K-flat scalar counits. These transitions commute with the strict Koszul augmentations, the localized two-term comparisons, and the prescribed tensor/Roos/tail comparison for every strict tower and every tail. No regularity or existence of normalized models is asserted here.

proof.text: The ideal inclusion (s^(m+1)) <= (s^(k+1)) gives sectionwise quotient maps. Their naturality and compatibility with the quotient projections survive sheafification. Compose restriction along q with restriction to R by the identity on underlying sections. Apply the two specified ordinary adjunctions to their units to obtain e; its unit equation and linearity give the pure-section formula.

proof.text: The strict Koszul unit inclusion commutes with the cone transitions. The degree-zero cone inclusion is an isomorphism on the degree-zero term, so the ordinary-unit identity proves the augmentation square on degree-zero tensor summands. Both sides vanish on every other Koszul degree by Normalization.

proof.text: Conjugate the localized strict tensor transition by the two A isomorphisms. Fullness of precomposition with localization descends this natural transformation to c on the derived category. Its A square is immediate and its K-flat counit equation follows by the two A_kflat normalization equations and the augmentation square.

proof.text: The canonical tensor/product comparisons commute with the Koszul transition by product extensionality and naturality. Check the tensor/Roos square on every total-tensor summand and the two biproduct coordinates; the same sign (-1)^a occurs on both previous-degree components. Substitute this square, deletion naturality, the A square, and norm naturality into the explicit comparison composite.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRoosCoefficientCompatibility (M : Models R s)
    (hM : Normalization R s M) : ∀ (k m : ℕ) (hkm : k ≤ m),
    ∃ q : B R s m ⟶ B R s k,
      quotient R s m ≫ q = quotient R s k ∧
      ∃ e : (M.scalar m).E ⋙ restriction R s m ⟶
          (M.scalar k).E ⋙ restriction R s k,
        (∀ (P : Modules R) (U : Cᵒᵖ) (b : (B R s m).obj.obj U) (x : P.val.obj U),
          (e.app P).val.app U (pure R s m (M.scalar m) P U b x) =
            pure R s k (M.scalar k) P U ((q.hom.app U).hom b) x) ∧
        ∃ c : (M.scalar m).T ⋙ (restriction R s m).mapDerivedCategory ⟶
            (M.scalar k).T ⋙ (restriction R s k).mapDerivedCategory,
          (∀ (P : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ),
            CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := R) P →
            c.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
                (restriction R s k).mapDerivedCategory.map ((M.scalar k).ε.app P) ≫
                (restriction R s k).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
                  (((M.scalar k).E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
              (restriction R s m).mapDerivedCategory.map ((M.scalar m).ε.app P) ≫
                (restriction R s m).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
                  (((M.scalar m).E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫
                DerivedCategory.Q.map
                  ((ordinaryTransition R s (M.scalar m) (M.scalar k) e).app P)) ∧
          (∀ P : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ,
            (tensorStep R s hkm).app P ≫ (M.aug k).app P =
              (M.aug m).app P ≫ (ordinaryTransition R s (M.scalar m) (M.scalar k) e).app P) ∧
          (∀ P : CochainComplex (Modules R) ℤ,
            DerivedCategory.Q.map ((tensorStep R s hkm).app P) ≫ (M.A k).hom.app P =
              (M.A m).hom.app P ≫ c.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ∧
          (∀ (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules R) ℤ) (h : ℕ),
            c.app (M.RF.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X)) ≫ M.comparison R s X k h =
              M.comparison R s X m h ≫ M.RF.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map
                ((tail R h).map ((onTowersMap R (tensorStep R s hkm)).app X))))
